sources.title: orcasoceaneffects/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The released checkpoints (SVD/SVD-XT) are image-to-video models that generate short videos/animations closely following the given input image. Since the model relies on an existing supplied image, the potential risks of disclosing specific material or novel unsafe content are minimal.

sources.title: stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) Image-to-Video is a diffusion model that takes in a still image as a conditioning frame, and generates a video from it.
